title: MigrationValidationReport
description: The per-source-table count/checksum reconciliation report produced by the Validator (design.md, Flow 'Validation report'). Satisfies R11. Carries only counts, keys, and outcome codes — never a personal-data field (requirements.md R22), so this report itself needs no special handling to view or store.

runId.description: The migration run this report was generated against.

generatedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of report generation.

runStatus.description: Whether the run this report describes had reached completed status at generation time. A report generated against 'in-progress' must be read as partial, never as a final reconciliation (design.md, Flow 'Validation report' failure path).

sourceTable.description: The legacy source table this row reconciles, e.g. 'pp_brokerage', 'pp_agency_cga'.

sourceRecordCount.description: Count of rows in this table's staged snapshot.

sourceChecksum.description: A field-level checksum of the staged snapshot, used to detect a mismatch against the migrated target content beyond a simple count comparison.

migratedCount.description: Count of MigrationLog rows for this sourceTable with outcome 'migrated'.

skippedCount.description: Count of MigrationLog rows for this sourceTable with outcome 'skipped'. Reported separately — never folded into migratedCount (design.md, Flow 'Validation report').

failedCount.description: Count of MigrationLog rows for this sourceTable with outcome 'failed'.

unaccountedCount.description: sourceRecordCount minus (migratedCount + skippedCount + failedCount) — a staged row with no terminal MigrationLog row at all. Non-zero here is the report's headline finding: the phase controller's own completion check should never permit this (design.md, Flow 'Validation report').

checksumMatch.description: Whether the migrated target content's own checksum, recomputed from the target-schema records this sourceTable's migrated rows point to (via MigrationLog.targetId), matches sourceChecksum.

discrepancyNotes.description: Human-readable notes on any mismatch found — never a field value itself, only identifying keys and outcome codes, per data-classification rules.

discrepancyNotes: 1 staged pp_agency_cga row has no terminal MigrationLog row — investigate before declaring cutover complete.
